name: Gether
overview: Gether is a male biblical figure identified as the son of Aram, as recorded in Genesis 10:23. Beyond this genealogical note, Scripture provides no further details about his tribe or additional attributes. His mention situates him within the broader genealogical framework of the descendants of Noah's son Shem.
namesAndTitles: The name Gether appears as a proper name in Genesis 10:23. No specific meaning or divine origin is associated with his name in the biblical text, and thus it is presented plainly without additional interpretive significance.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture explicitly records Gether as the son of Aram, establishing his direct paternal relationship. No other family relationships or tribal affiliations are detailed in the biblical record beyond this connection.
scriptureSignificance: Gether's significance lies primarily in his place within the genealogical record of Genesis, contributing to the biblical account of the nations descending from Shem. Although no narrative events or theological roles are attributed to him, his mention helps trace the lineage through which God's providential plan unfolds in history. This genealogy underscores the faithfulness of God's promises through successive generations.
